articles.summary: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) reported today that strike notice has been received at Highland Valley Copper (HVC) Operations from the United Steelworkers (USW) Local 7619.
articles.title: Teck Receives Highland Valley Copper Operations Strike Notice

articles.summary: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) announced today that strike action by United Steelworkers (USW) Local 7619 has commenced at Teck's Highland Valley Copper (HVC) Operations in B.C.
